part.text:
If **UserService** goes down, **6 services are affected within two hops**:

| Distance | Affected service | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|
| 1 hop | ApiGateway | ApiGateway → UserService |
| 1 hop | AuditService | AuditService → UserService |
| 1 hop | OrderService | OrderService → UserService |
| 2 hops | BillingService | BillingService → OrderService → UserService |
| 2 hops | ReportingService | ReportingService → OrderService → UserService |
| 2 hops | SearchService | SearchService → OrderService → UserService |

Arrows mean “depends on.” The lookup included both service dependencies and API callers, treating a service and its exposed API as one place. All returned paths were direct service dependencies; no named APIs, databases, or configuration keys appeared in these results.
